paragraphs: On Friday afternoon, Tom sat at the table with his laptop. Teacher Nick gave his class a new music game, and Tom wanted to try it. The game is for children who want to make music. He downloaded the software at four o'clock. Lily came and sat next to him, and Pip lay under the table. "Can I play, too?" she asked. "Yes, but first read the instructions," said Tom.

This is what the first screen said. "Welcome to Little Band." "Type your password, and click Start." Tom typed his password, and Lily clicked Start. The second screen showed three pictures. "Choose an instrument: guitar, piano, or drum." "I choose the piano," said Lily.

The third screen gave the first step. "Click the piano four times. Listen to each sound." Lily clicked the piano three times and stopped. The screen said, "Try again." "I forgot one click," said Lily. She clicked four times, and she listened to each sound. The screen said, "Great! Level two." Pip put his head out from under the table and listened to the music.

"Level two has a clock, and I feel a bit nervous," said Lily. "Do not worry," said Tom. "You can do it." The instructions on the screen said, "Click the guitar, then the piano, then the drum." "You have ten seconds." The clock on the screen went from ten to zero. Lily clicked fast, but she clicked the drum first. The screen said, "Try again." This time, she looked at the order before she clicked.

She clicked the guitar, the piano, and the drum in the right order. The screen said, "Well done! Level three." A new message came at the bottom of the screen. "To go further, make a song with three instruments." "That is hard," said Lily, "but it looks fun." Tom clapped for her, and Pip wagged his tail. "We can play it after dinner," said Tom. Mom called them to the table, and Tom closed the laptop. Lily smiled and said, "I like this game, and I like the sound of the piano."
text.summary: Tom shows Lily a music game called Little Band on his laptop. Lily follows the instructions on each screen and reads the feedback, and she goes up to a new level.
